final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Health-chain walk on namespace boutique: pods -o wide shows a single outlier, shippingservice-dcf97c8fd-lkfpz, at 0/1 Running with 3 RESTARTS (0s ago) while all 10 other pods are 1/1 Running with 0 restarts; deployments confirm shippingservice is the only workload at 0/1 AVAILABLE. Pod detail shows Last State Terminated, Reason Error, Exit Code 2 (not 137/OOMKilled), Ready False. The mechanism events bind it exactly: kubelet 'Liveness probe failed: Get "http://172.20.1.120:50051/": net/http: HTTP/1.x transport connection broken: malformed HTTP response "\x00\x00\x06\x04..."' (that byte pattern is an HTTP/2 SETTINGS frame) x9 over 83s, followed by 'Container server failed liveness probe, will be restarted' x3 over 63s. GetAppYAML(shippingservice) closes the configuration surface: readinessProbe uses grpc on port 50051 (correct) while livenessProbe uses httpGet path=/ port=50051 against the same gRPC-only HTTP/2 port - the HTTP/1.x liveness probe can never succeed, so kubelet continuously kills and restarts the container. Container logs show the app itself starts healthily ('Shipping Service listening on port :50051'), so the termination is probe-induced, not application failure; namespace events add no other warning.
